skills.name: kiln-shelf-slots
skills.when: Any step that reads, writes or searches the slots of a kiln.Shelf
skills.body: Shelf slots are numbered from 1 to shelf.size. Slot 0 does not exist: shelf.get(0) returns None and shelf.put(0, item) is silently ignored. shelf.find(item) returns the slot number, or 0 when the item is not on the shelf. To visit every slot use range(1, shelf.size + 1).
